name: Vox

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Intensify: Yeni oluşturulan tüm buff'ların gücünü bir yüzde artırır.
abilityDetails.Undermine: Aktifken saldırılar Otomatik Blok ile engellenemez.
abilityDetails.Neutralize: Buff yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.

signatureAbility:
Lethal Edge
Contact with the blade of Vox's scythe increases the damage of active personal Degenerations on the Opponent by [0.5 - 3]%.
Each time Vox's personal Degenerations are inflicted, the next time Vox strikes the Opponent's Block or the Opponent activates an Unblockable or Unstoppable effect, the Degenerations are paused for [1 - 2] seconds.
Vox can toggle a Pre-Fight ability to Never Back Down during a fight, preventing them from moving backwards when they dodge. This option is remembered between fights.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Vox's super-Inhuman physiology grants them Immunity to Poison, Power Burn, Power Drain, Power Lock and Special Lock.
The Precision Buffs granted by the Dexterity Mastery have no stack limit, and fall off one at a time with each of Vox's attacks.
Personal Degenerations are paused during Vox's Special Attacks as long as the entire attack strikes the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Corrupted
content: Through twisted Kree bioengineering, the Vox have been granted the power of Corrupted Buffs. These Buffs have 300% Ability Accuracy and last indefinitely. However, when one is Nullified, Vox instantly takes a burst of [7,960.1] Direct Damage.

When a non-Corrupted Fury, Cruelty, Precision, Armor Up, Intensify, Undermine, or  Vigilance Buff expires off of Vox or an #Inhuman Opponent for any reason other than Nullify, Vox gains a matching Corrupted Buff. Furies obtained this way cannot exceed 20% of Vox's base Attack Rating.
Corrupted Buffs have a stack limit of 10 except Intensify, which has a stack limit of 30.
Vox's Medium Attacks grant them a Corrupted Fury Buff with potency [532.85].
Vox's first and fourth Light Attacks grant them a Corrupted Cruelty Buff with potency [56.12].
When struck by a Medium Attack, Vox gains a Corrupted Armor Up Buff with potency [144.74].

abilitySections.title: On Final Hit Of Special Attacks 1 & 2
content: If none of Vox's personal Degenerations are on the Opponent, for each Corrupted Buff on Vox, inflict a Degeneration Debuff that deals [426.28] Direct Damage over a fixed 13 seconds. Consume all Corrupted Buffs.
If any of Vox's personal Degenerations are on the Opponent, consume all of them and then Vox gains a 2% Corrupted Intensify for each Degeneration consumed this way.
These Degeneration effects increase the damage they deal by 10% for each second they have been on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain an Undermine Buff for 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a Vigilance Buff for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This attack deals True Damage and gains +[745.99] Attack Rating for each Corrupted Intensify on Vox, then converts all Corrupted Buffs into Corrupted Intensifies.
If the Opponent is an #Inhuman, inflict a non-stacking 100% Neutralize Debuff that lasts indefinitely.
